corruptSays.line:
Travel 3 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
The stash count is off. 2 stones missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 plant fiber missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
Diana looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
Word reaches you, days late: Piper stands accused over what happened to Diana. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Diana has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Piper answers for what happened to Diana.
Diana calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Hard Candy
Butterscotch, doled out like medals — good report card, brave dentist visit, the day the dog died. Small sweetness, on purpose.

◈ FLASHBACK — Reading Glasses
You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Leah next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.
Word reaches you, days late: Piper stands accused over what happened to Diana. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
Diana calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.

Tashi leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Wren.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
They're named, every one: Ellis Delgado, Sanne Haddad. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📓 Codex: 2 petitioners from Thornfield (cannibal): Ellis Delgado, Sanne Haddad.
💛 The Dispatcher's headset has become something you can reach for. (Keepsake L2 — new combat action: Steady. Hold it and breathe: clear fear and stun on yourself. Once per fight.)
💛 The Reading Glasses has become something you can reach for. (Keepsake L2 — new combat action: Steady. Hold it and breathe: clear fear and stun on yourself. Once per fight.)
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Ellis nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Lena.
They're named, every one: Rafael Nair. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU!"
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Rafael nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

"The ring light BRIGHTENS before it acts. It doesn't fight you — it turns the AUDIENCE against you: fans become haters, care packages stop, System favor drains. Its followers are literal — small fan-creatures that buff it. Kill them first." "‘This Ratio is brought to you by—’ The followers glow with sponsored light. They hit harder now."
